readTimestamp (line 269) reads a fully attacker-chosen 64-bit value, so every wrapped product is already reachable without any overflow (v=Long.MAX_VALUE yields Date(-1000), identical to sending v=-1); no bound is bypassed and no capability is gained, and the claim's stated overflow threshold `Long.MAX_VALUE/1000 (~9.22e18)` is wrong by six orders of magnitude (it is 9,223,372,036,854,775).

Case 'F' (line 181) -> readTable -> readFieldValue (line 150) and case 'A' (line 184) -> readArray -> readFieldValue (line 245) form mutual recursion with no depth parameter or counter anywhere in the file; each nesting level costs only ~5-6 wire bytes ('A' + 4-byte length), so thousands of frames of stack are reachable from a single small payload.
